description.en: The tag key for a fuzzy query.

description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

description.zh:
资源类型。

取值：Account，表示资源目录的成员。
description.en:
The resource type.

The value Account indicates the members of the resource directory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster list-tag-keys --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --max-results 10 --resource-type Account --key-filter team --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster ListTagKeys --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --KeyFilter team --MaxResults 10 --ResourceType Account
